test_web_ui_build_staleness: test the web UI build staleness check that compares source files against the vite manifest timestamp
test_web_ui_build_needed_dist_missing: test that _web_ui_build_needed returns true when the dist directory is missing
test_web_ui_build_needed_vite_manifest_f: test that _web_ui_build_needed returns false when the vite manifest is newer than source files
test_web_ui_build_needed_source_newer: test that _web_ui_build_needed returns true when source files are newer than the vite manifest
test_build_web_ui_skips_npm: test that _build_web_ui skips npm install and build when the dist is already fresh
